text:
Maya R: Hey team — finalizing the X/LinkedIn schedule for next week's Redwood Inference launch + companion webinar. Need quick alignment on copy, hero assets, and inbound routing.
Samir P: Got it. Main ask: two launch posts (X + LinkedIn), one X thread with 3-4 tweets, and a webinar reminder post 24h before.
Ashley K: I'll prep hero image + 3 stat cards. Which benchmarks do we want on the stat cards?
Maya R: Use latency and cost numbers: p95 latency 110ms on hosted API, 3.4x cost improvement vs baseline for our recommended batching. Short headline copy: "Predictable LLM inference—fast, cheaper, reliable."
Leo T: For the X thread, let's lead with the customer problem, then benchmark, then CTA to webinar. Quick outline:
```
1) Problem: inference surprises kill UX + costs.
2) Benchmark: p95 110ms, 3.4x cost-win with batching+cache.
3) How: runtime + routing + rollout controls.
4) CTA: demo/webinar link + seedlist.
```
Samir P: Copy drafts:
- X headline: "Ship LLM features without surprise latency or bills. Join our launch webinar."
- LinkedIn opener: "We built an inference platform that makes production LLMs predictable—here's how."
Maya R: Nice. Add a line about Dedicated & Private as options for enterprise.
Devlin: For tracking, we need UTM params: utm_source=social, utm_medium=x vs linkedin, utm_campaign=launch_march2026. Also tag HubSpot form id: 4521 for webinar signups.
Ashley K: I'll drop hero.png, stat-card-1.png, stat-card-2.png to the /marketing-assets/launch folder by EOD. Any size preferences?
Maya R: 1200x675 for X hero, 1080x1080 for carousel stat cards. Make alt text: "Redwood Inference launch benchmark card".
Samir P: Routing: attendees from webinar -> HubSpot list "Launch Webinar Mar2026" -> SDR nurturing flow. @Devlin can you confirm auto-assignment rule to SDR queue?
Devlin: Confirmed. New signups with utm_campaign=launch_march2026 get tag "launch_webinar" and assigned to SDR rotation A. Also send webhook to /internal/leads for immediate follow-up.
social-bot: Suggested post times (based on past engagement): X thread: Tue 10:30am PT, LinkedIn long post: Tue 1:00pm PT, Webinar reminder: Mon 24h before at 9:00am PT.
Leo T: For the X thread CTA we should include a 1-click link to the registration + a short form fallback. Suggest: short link -> /r/launch-march (with the UTMs).
Maya R: Creative asks for copy variations: short CTA, soft CTA (learn more), and webinar-first CTA. Also need 2 subject lines for registration emails.
Samir P: I'll write 3 tweet variants and 2 LinkedIn captions by EOD.
Ashley K: I'll tag the files with copy versions (v1/v2/v3) and include a versioned Figma link.
Maya R: Great. Last: follow-up play for engaged replies on X — send to community manager for 1:1 replies, compile high-intent leads (link clicks + signups) and add to SDR list. Who owns the thread responses during the first 24h?
Leo T: I'll own the first 6 hours. @Samir you take the evening window.
Maya R: Perfect. If no blockers, we push assets + copy to scheduler by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
Samir P: FYI — I'll seed the initial paid boost for the launch tweet (small spend) and report CTR in the morning after launch.
Devlin: Done — set tracking hooks and Slack alert to #sales when signups hit 25.
Maya R: That covers it. If anyone needs to change times/copy, update here before 5pm PT.
